description: How large one uploaded file may be in this company: 'effectiveMegabytes' is what an issue's or a wiki page's file, a pasted picture and a document sent to a checklist item are held to. A chat's file, a secret file, add_attachment / add_wiki_attachment and pm-files are held to the smaller of it and the platform's. 'megabytes' is the company's own choice, null for the platform's ('platformMegabytes'); 'raised' says a platform administrator set it above the platform's, which only the platform can. 'mayChange' says whether you may change it — the company's administrators, with set_file_size_limit.
name: get_file_size_limit
title: Get file size limit
